title: Output-conditional decision tree cost
statement: For a randomized decision tree computing $f$ on a finite, nonempty input alphabet, and for an output value $v$, define its output-conditional cost to be the maximum, over all inputs, of the input cost when $f$ equals $v$, and zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: the output type has decidable equality
